title: Hug of Death
description:
Your side project just hit #1 on the front page, and you are the load balancer. Route traffic to servers before they melt, block scraper bots, and spend what you earn on servers, a CDN, a rate limiter or an SRE. Keep uptime above 90% until the post falls off the front page.

Controls: tap or click a server (or press 1–6) to route traffic there. Tap red bots to block them. Q/W/E/R/T buy upgrades. P pauses, M mutes.
author: Chakravarthi
